title: WhatsApp booking message that confirms time and seat
simple_explanation: When a customer asks for a slot on WhatsApp, reply fast with the time, the service, and the seat. This stops double-bookings and calms the fear of waiting.
do_this: Open WhatsApp Business and keep the chat reply short.
Type the service name, the time slot, and ask 'Shall I fix this for you?'
Save this reply as a quick reply on WhatsApp Business so you can send it in 2 seconds.
Send the salon address pin from your location card after they say yes.
copy_ready_text: Hi {{customerName}}, your {{serviceName}} is fixed for {{timeSlot}} at {{businessName}}, {{location}}. Please come 5 minutes early. Reply YES to confirm. Thank you!
example_for_business: At {{businessName}} in {{location}}, the owner saves this message as WhatsApp Quick Reply #1. When a customer messages for a haircut slot, she taps the quick reply, adds the time, and sends. She then sends the Google Maps pin from the business profile.
why_this_works: Customers want a clear yes-or-no answer. A short message with time, service, and place removes confusion and stops no-shows. Quick replies save the owner typing the same thing 10 times a day.
how_to_know_it_worked: Check your WhatsApp chat at end of day. Count how many bookings were confirmed with a YES reply. You can also check your appointment register for fewer walk-in queries asking 'Is my slot still on?'
